share_app_text:
Ikaze muri Vitaway Plus!

Vitaway ni urubuga rw'ubuzima rugufasha kwikurikirana no kwivuza unyuze murandasi. Kugenzura ibipimo by'ubuzima nk'amaraso, ibiro, isukari mumaraso, n'ibindi byoroshye. Gira ibiganiro kuri murandasi hamwe n’abajyanama b’ubuzima b'inzobere, abaforomo, n’abaganga kugira ngo baguhe ubufasha bwihariye n’inama. Ganira nabo binyuze kuri video, amajwi n’ubutumwa. Bika inyandiko zo kwa muganga aho zitabura kugira ngo abaganga bacu babanze bazisuzume mbere yo kubonana. Fata ubuyobozi ku buzima bwawe hamwe na Vitaway uyu munsi.

🔑 Ibyingenzi:
- Gukurikirana ubuzima
- Ibipimo by’ubuzima
- Kugenzura amaraso
- Ibiro
- Kugenzura glucose y’amaraso
- Guhura kuri murandasi
- Umujyanama w'ubuzima
- Gufashwa n’abaforomo
- Gufashwa n’abaganga
- Ibyiganiro bya video
- Ibyiganiro by'amajwi
- Inyandiko z’ubuzima
- Gusigasira ubuzima
- Ubuyobozi bw’ubuzima

Sobanukirwa byinshi kandi tangira hamwe na Vitaway Plus hano: https://bit.ly/4c99Nwk

#VitawayPlus #IkurikiranaUbuzima #UbufashaBwoKurandasi #UbuyoboziBwUbuzima
intro_text: Fashwa kugenzura diyabete yawe, umuvuduko w’amaraso, n’izindi ndwara, byihuse kandi byoroshye!
nutrition_text: Ibiryo byihariye hamwe n’imirire iboneye iri hafi yawe. Byaruta kubara calorie, App igufasha kugera ku mirire yuzuye iboneye ku mibereho yawe kandi ikubereye. Geraho intego zo gutakaza ibiro ndetse no gusigasira imirire y’ubuzima bwawe iburindwe igihe cyose.
care_text: Vitaway Ubuzima ikubwira ubufasha bwose ukeneye, ku buryo bworoshye kandi ku giciro kigororotse. Uzabona ibyo ukeneye ngo ukire – harimo ubufasha bwa 24/7 – hamwe no kuvurwa kwa mbere, kwivuza kw’ubujyanama n’ibiganiro bigufasha kuguma mu buzima bwiza. Kubona abaganga n’ingo z’ubuzima zubakiye ku makuru agezweho biroroshye.
seamless_care_text: App yacu izana hamwe abaganga, abajyanama, abajyanama b’imirire, abaforomo, abajyanama, n’ibiganiro bigufasha muri byose bijyanye n'ubuzima bwawe. Niba ukeneye ubufasha bwihariye, turaguhitiramo abaganga n’ubuvuzi burimo ibigo byegereye aho utuye. Ariko ntudukerense.
personal_care_text: Abaganga n’abajyanama ba Vitaway Ubuzima bazakumenya byimbitse. Ibiganiro bya video n’amajwi nta gihe byishyiriraho. Ahubwo, ntizishobora gukorwa mu minota 15 ahubwo zishobora gufata isaha muganira ku buzima bwawe mukagena intambwe zikurikira mwese.
subscription_text: Vitaway Ubuzima ishobora kuboneka ku buntu kandi kuyikoresha bigashyirwa hamwe n’ibindi bintu bike. Kugira ngo ubone ibyuzuye bya Vitaway, turatanga gahunda ya Premium yo kwiyandikisha ku kwezi kumwe, amezi 3, cyangwa imyaka yose yo kwiyandikisha ikomeza.
secure_confidential_text: Twitaye ku mutekano wawe. Amakuru yawe y’ubuzima abitswe neza kandi yemejwe na serivise ya RISA yo kubika amakuru.
stay_on_top_text: Guma imbere mu buzima bwawe, kugenzura ibipimo byawe, kugenzura imiti ukoresha hamwe na Vitaway, kandi ugire gahunda ikurikiza umunsi ku munsi mu buzima bwawe.
